book.name: Loma
book.title: LOMA MeLoma ꞌidi leta Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Paulo ꞌina gwae helau
Nuwamiya yalagu nuhudai Pibe weyahina, tauna ꞌiꞌabiꞌabihetena ꞌasa Kenikiliya ꞌidi hekalesiya ꞌoina,

ma ꞌeguma to tuta ꞌitauyawa ꞌoimiya nuwanuwagu watoe ꞌimi hada ꞌida Bada saninega, weyahina mumuga bewa gide Yehoba ꞌina topaihowao ꞌilobwainediya, ma wete Pibeina ꞌeguma toꞌaha ꞌoinega ꞌitoꞌutoꞌupa waꞌabihete, weyahina tauna gide ꞌipaipaihowa ꞌesedi tohekalesiyao baibaiwadi ꞌihehelauwedi, taugu gide ꞌlemegauwa.
Cigu helau wete wahepwaile Pilisila ma Akuila ꞌoidiya, taudi mahetegwao mwalo Yesu Keliso weyahina ꞌahetopaihowa,

ma wete yawasidi sitagwaleya weyahigu saugaina ꞌebe hesilae ꞌoidiya. Ta weyahidi yaloyauwedo madouna, ma geya ꞌabehega taugumo ꞌigu loyauwedo, ma tohekalesiya ꞌasaidi ꞌatamanega wete mahetegwao ꞌima loyauwedo siteluwaedi weyahidi.
Ta ꞌigu helau wete wahepwaile tohekalesiyaedi siꞌetoꞌetoꞌauta Akuila ꞌina hada. Ma ꞌiyagu Epinito weteyage ꞌoina yahelauwa, tauna Yesu Keliso ꞌana tohemisa nugenugetaina Esiya ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌoina.
Meli wete ꞌoina yahelauwa, tauna weyahimi ꞌiꞌalaꞌiꞌiwasa madouna.

Ciyagwao Anidaloniko ma Diuniya wete ꞌoidiya yahelauwa, taudi meYudiya, mwalo mahetegwao deliya ꞌamiyamiya, siteluwaedi maꞌadi ꞌamayaba Yesu ꞌana tohepwailao ꞌoidiyega, weyahina taudi tohekalesiya nugenugetadi ꞌabwa muliyega taugu.
Ta wete ꞌiyagu moisa Amipiliya ꞌoina yahelauwa, tauna ꞌida Bada ꞌana tohemisa ꞌaigeda.
Ma wete ꞌigu helau Ulibano ꞌoina, tauna mahetedai Keliso weyahina tapaipaihowa. Ta wete ꞌiyagu Sitakisi ꞌoina yahelauwa.
Cigu helau wete Apeli ꞌoina, tauna Keliso ꞌana tohemisa moisa. Ma Alisitobulo maꞌina susuwao ꞌoidiya wete yahelauwa,
Ta Helodiyami weteyage, tauna ꞌigu susu gwama Yudiya ꞌaigeda, eema tohekalesiyaedi taudi Nakiso ma ꞌina susuwao wete ꞌoidiya yahelauwa.
Cigu helau wete Talipina ma Taliposa, taudi ꞌida Bada ꞌina topaihowao ꞌoidiya. Ta ꞌiyagu Pelisi wete ꞌoina yahelauwa, tauna Bada ꞌina paihowa weyahina ꞌiꞌalaꞌiꞌiwasa madouna.
Ta wete Lupuso ꞌoina yahelauwa, tauna topaihowa bwebweꞌana ꞌida Bada weyahina, ma sinanaina weteyage ꞌoina yahelauwa, tauna ꞌagu tohelau, gide ꞌabwa taugu natuna moisa.
Cigu helau weteyage Asinikilito ma Pilegoni ma Helimi ma Pataloba ma Helimasi, ta tohekalesiyaedi mahetediyao wete ꞌoidiya.
Weteyage yahelauwa Pilologo ma Diuliya ꞌoidiya, ta wete Neliusa manuhuna ꞌoidiya. Wete Olimipasi ma Yehoba ꞌina tomotaiyedi mahetediyao ꞌoidiya yahelauwa.
Caigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌiyamiyaowedi mahetemiyao heꞌiyaꞌiyagu ꞌana moisega waꞌatusapwalidi. Ta wete tohekalesiyao mabwaiyadi tupwa baibaiwana ꞌoidiyega, ꞌidi helau tohekalesiyao tupwa Loma ꞌoimiya.
Paulo ꞌina henuwalagu ꞌana ꞌebe losaloha

Tasigwao bewa ꞌigu ꞌahwanoi madouna ꞌoimiya, beno waꞌitayahigomi towatahao ꞌoidiyega, weyahina heꞌitaedi waꞌewediya taudi ꞌadi wahiꞌwata, ꞌoinega ta siꞌahwaꞌahwa galegale ma weteyage tomota ꞌidi hemisa siꞌabiꞌabi heweꞌadi.

Ceguma taiyawedi ꞌidi paihowa bewa gidemusa taudi geya ꞌida Bada Yesu Keliso weyahina sida paihowa, ma beno siboi tuwa ꞌidi nuwatuhu siꞌeꞌepaihowadi, weyahina ꞌidi gwaeyao hoto hedada, ma tomota weꞌaweꞌadi siꞌeꞌeꞌaboꞌabowedi ma silisilisi hiledi.

Ma ꞌomi hesiyage tomota mabwaiyadi sisanapugomi ꞌabehega tetela bwebweꞌana ꞌana tohematamatanao, ta weyahimi yayaliyaya madouna. Eema nuwanuwagu mumuga bwebweꞌana mabwaiyana wasanapu bwaibwainidi ta mumuga galadi walogwahatedi.
Moisa Yehoba tauna daumwala huhuna, ta nata Seitani ꞌiꞌahusepale mwayamwayauwe ꞌoimiyega. Cida Bada Yesu Keliso ꞌina helau ꞌoimiya.
Bewa Timoti ma taugu ꞌima helau ꞌoimiya, Timoti tauna mahetegu ꞌapaipaihowa, ma tupwana wete ꞌiyamayao meYudiya taudi Lukiyo ta Yesoni, ta Sosipateli.
Leta bewa taugu Talitiyasi yalele, Paulo weyahina, ma yahelauwa ꞌoimiya ꞌida Bada saninega.

Ma loheyaina bewa ꞌina hada ꞌamiyamiya, sanina Geyo, ꞌihelauwa ꞌoimiya, hada bewama tohekalesiyao ꞌidi ꞌebe ꞌetoꞌauta. Ma Elasito wete, ꞌasa madouna bewa ꞌana mane ꞌana toꞌitayahina, ta tasidai Kwatasi sihelauwa ꞌoimiya.
Coinega tuta bewa Yehoba tahepwatuwe, weyahina tauna sawasawahina ꞌiꞌabihe waiwaiyegomi, ꞌigu loguguyaina ꞌoinega, Yesu Keliso tetelina weyahina. Mwalona tetelaina dahwadahwaina,

ta bewa tutaina ꞌiꞌabi latuheya ꞌoida, palopitao ꞌidi leleyao ꞌoidiyega, ma wete Yehoba miyamiya hatayana ꞌigwaeya ꞌabehega tetela bewa ꞌasa mabwaiyadi ꞌana tomotaiyao sida sanapu, ma ꞌane sihemisa ma simuliye.
Yehoba taunamo tosanapu moisa, ꞌoinega sawasawahina Yesu Keliso saninega tahepwatuwe tuta mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya. Emeni.
